左手移动：摇杆直接控制方向，顶住障碍时不会自动绕路，斜推才沿边移动；松开停止，冰:
Move with the left stick. Pushing straight into a wall stops you; add sideways input to move along it. Release to stop; ice retains momentum.
Hold a pass / shot or skill button and drag to aim. For ground-targeted skills, drag farther to increase distance. Release to cast, or release in the red cancel area to cancel. A quick tap casts in your facing direction.
You can move while aiming. Charged skills keep their original preparation time.

Blue shows range; gold shows direction or trajectory. The ball preview shows a simplified two-second arc, excluding collisions and rebounds. Actual shots still use normal physics. Self-targeted skills use your current facing.

Tap an ally portrait on the left to control them. Gold marks the selected hero; the small dot marks possession. Switching clears the previous hero's touch input.
Tap Sprint to toggle it. The blue outer ring shows remaining mana, drains with use and refills with regeneration. Tap Powershot again while charging to cancel.
Keeper Jump is available in your own goal area when eligible and not holding the real ball. Cooldown: 2 seconds. The button is grey when unavailable.

The menu also offers tap-to-move. In that mode, use two fingers to pan / zoom; tap Follow to restore tracking.
More contains practice refill, ball recall, obstacles and mutation reset.
Android Back first cancels aim, then pauses. Backgrounding also pauses.
This is a single-player build.

The 60-second benchmark restarts the match and runs 3v3, half resolution, then 6v6. Copy the report afterward.
The number after FPS is the cap. P95 means 95% of frames took no longer than this. Slow-frame counts cover the last 10 seconds. CPU is game processing time; unavailable GPU timing does not mean the GPU is idle.
